source_findings: New budgeted_winner_loss matches the agreed seven-set, threshold-shifted GT winner versus highest predicted legal nonwinner hinge. Natural mean over every query and all seven sets.
GT labels are used only in the objective. Existing DECISION_FIELDS, model classes, inference/select_actions, search supervision and old ranking helper are unchanged.
Prediction scores already include the .01 extra-action bias; the helper subtracts it once only from GT utility. Both target and predicted decision scores receive the unchanged .03 nonkeep offset.
GT best_value <=0 explicitly selects regular keep, preserving strict intervention semantics.
The helper uses the MASKED rival max value. Actual singleton original-only sets therefore yield relu(-inf)=0 without a fabricated illegal rival or fallback branch.
Each set contains original plus at most one extra region, masked by exact action_valid. Illegal and incompatible extra candidates do not become rivals.
The old pairwise helper remains unchanged, and budgeted mode is selected only through the new objective branch and trainer CLI choice.
All other losses retain the existing matched-comparator settings. In particular, write_pair_calibration remains disabled in both future-policy comparator and new runner.

Both teacher arms retain the matched cache, seed42, B384, 3-epoch/9-update M0 and 60-epoch/180-update full settings. Frozen C1, optimizer, native threshold and full-video checkpoint policy are unchanged.
Runner restores CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID and existing LD_LIBRARY_PATH, OMP, Torch/cache/TMP/CUBLAS settings; full evaluation uses the unchanged main-repository wrapper.

independent_saved_score_replay.scope: Stored scores and GT utility from three detailed VAL queries per checkpoint; no models or neural-network forwards; score-tensor backward only; no optimizer or GPU

non_blocking_limitations: Loss/design PASS is not actual M0 completion or evidence of improved full-video/native accuracy.
Both completed future-policy full98 runs remain negative relative to old own4. Retain old own4 as the protected best, and compare the new loss to the matched future-policy objective controls.
Keep cases remain 4981/6314 own TRAIN budget sets. No positive-only filtering, 50:50 reweighting, threshold changes or quality-argmax policy was introduced.

Candidate-relative cost in the target intentionally matches the unchanged selector. Actual full-video validation must still charge .01 whenever search runs, including cases that keep a local candidate.

The independent saved-score replay used three detailed development queries per checkpoint and scalar score-tensor backward only; no model forward, optimizer, embeddings or CUDA. It is an arithmetic check, not an accuracy estimate.
